name: Emeria's Call // Emeria, Shattered Skyclave
oracle_text: Create two 4/4 white Angel Warrior creature tokens with flying. Non-Angel creatures you control gain indestructible until your next turn.
blocked_sentences: Create two 4/4 white Angel Warrior creature tokens with flying.

needs.what: a token definition for a 4/4 white Angel Warrior creature token with flying (subtypes Angel and Warrior), e.g. id angel_warrior_4_4_w_flying
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids is a closed list; the nearest entries are angel_4_4_w_flying (Angel only, no Warrior subtype) and angel_4_4_w_flying_vigilance (extra vigilance). Substituting angel_4_4_w_flying would drop the Warrior creature type, which matters for Warrior tribal effects.
